## API

Everything below is imported from `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/grid`.

### `GridSortableDirective`

**Selector:** `mona-grid[monaGridSortable]`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `monaGridSortable` | `SortableOptions \| ""` | `""` | Enables column sorting on the grid. Pass a `SortableOptions` object to configure sort mode, unsort behavior, or sort-index display. Sorting is on unless the object sets `enabled: false`. |
| `sort` (two-way) | `SortDescriptor[]` | `[]` | Current sort descriptors applied to the grid. Descriptors are kept even when no column shows the field, and a repeated field keeps its last descriptor. Supports two-way binding; a restored grid state updates it too. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `columnSort` | `ColumnSortEvent` | Emitted when a column header is activated to change its sort direction. Call `preventDefault()` on the event to cancel the sort. |
| `sortChange` | `SortDescriptor[]` | Emitted when `sort` changes. |

### `GridFilterableDirective`

**Selector:** `mona-grid[monaGridFilterable]`

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` (two-way) | `CompositeFilterDescriptor[]` | `[]` | Current filter descriptors applied to the grid. Conditions on one field show in that column's filter menu (repeated fields are combined with `and`); filters across fields, such as an `or` of two columns, are still applied and reported. Conditions with an unknown operator are ignored. Supports two-way binding. |
| `monaGridFilterable` | `Partial<FilterableOptions> \| ""` | `""` | Enables column filtering on the grid. Pass a `FilterableOptions` object to configure whether filters render in the header menu, a filter row, or both. Filtering is on unless the object sets `enabled: false`. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `filterChange` | `CompositeFilterDescriptor[]` | Emitted when `filter` changes. |

### `ColumnSortEvent`

**Extends:** `PreventableEvent`

#### Properties

| Name | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `column` (read-only) | `Column` |

### Types

#### `FilterableOptions`

| Name | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `boolean` |
| `type` | `"menu" \| "row" \| "menu, row"` |

#### `SortableOptions`

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allowUnsort?` | `boolean` | Whether a third click on a sorted column clears its sort. |
| `enabled?` | `boolean` | Whether sorting is active. On unless set to `false`; options replace earlier ones. |
| `mode?` | `"single" \| "multiple"` | Whether one or several columns can be sorted at once. |
| `showIndices?` | `boolean` | Whether sort order indices are displayed on header cells. |

#### `ColumnSortComparator`

Compares two cell values for sorting: negative, zero or positive, as for `Array.prototype.sort`.

```typescript
type ColumnSortComparator = { compare(left: unknown, right: unknown): number }["compare"];
```

#### `PreventableEvent`

From `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/common`.

**Type parameters:** `E extends Event = Event`

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `originalEvent` (read-only) | `E \| undefined` | The DOM event that caused this one, when there is one. |
| `type` (read-only) | `string \| undefined` | A name for the kind of event, when the component that emits it sets one. |

**Methods**

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `isDefaultPrevented(): boolean` | Whether `preventDefault()` was called. |
| `preventDefault(): void` | Cancels what the event announces, such as opening or closing a popup, or closing a dialog. |

#### `RangeFilterBound`

From `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/query`.

A bound of a range filter. `null` leaves that end open.


#### `RangeFilterDescriptor`

From `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/query`.

`between` and `notbetween` include both bounds.

```typescript
type RangeFilterDescriptor = FieldDefinition & { operator: RangeFilterOperators; value: readonly [from: RangeFilterBound, to: RangeFilterBound]; };
```

#### `SortDescriptor`

From `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/query`.

**Type parameters:** `TValue = unknown`

| Name | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `dir` | `SortDirection` |
| `field` | `string` |

**Methods**

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `sort(left: TValue, right: TValue): number` | Compares two values of `field` (not two rows). Return a negative number when `left` comes first in ascending order; `dir: "desc"` reverses the result. Empty values are passed in as they are. |
